title: IVT Aliquots
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Aliquot IVT into 2 ml tubes
steps.instruction: Perform custom IVT aliquoting for up to 24 reactions in 2 ml Eppendorf tubes; refer to the liquid layout section of your protocol in the Opentrons App for layout details.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters in the fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware files (JSON extensions) if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the Opentrons App; consult the support articles for calibration tips.
